description: Measured local deployment comparison for the controlled CrashLoop fixture; not a general diagnostic or hardware benchmark.

cpu_baseline.runtime: Docker Linux container, 8-CPU quota, 8 GiB limit

shutdown_verified: Owned native server and worker processes exited; loopback listener cleared. Restart through supported helper passed.
color_fix_verified: Dedicated launcher clears inherited NO_COLOR and TERM=dumb only with -Color; actual child PTY emitted true-color foreground/background sequences.
limitations: One controlled incident and three warm GPU runs; no general diagnostic success rate is established.
CPU container and native GPU deployment differ; this is a practical before/after comparison, not an isolated GPU microbenchmark.
Model already loaded before each investigation; initial loading, lab startup, and Go builds are excluded.
Citation checks verify the fixture finding and source references, not every model sentence.
